name: Desktop information architecture
expected: All required sections exist and anchor navigation targets are present.

name: Room selector interaction
expected: Selecting any room updates image, title, description and amenity pills.

name: Mobile navigation and sticky actions
expected: The mobile menu opens/closes and the bottom action rail provides working phone, Maps and booking links.

name: Gallery lightbox
expected: Gallery images open in an accessible modal; previous/next, backdrop close and Escape are wired.

name: Booking and contact channels
expected: All primary conversion links are present and point to the intended public hotel channels.

name: Accessibility baseline
expected: The page has one H1, semantic navigation/sections, keyboard focus, accessible modal controls and reduced-motion support.

name: SEO and structured data
expected: SEO metadata and factual Hotel structured data are present without invented ratings or pricing.

name: Branding and clean visual hierarchy
expected: The header uses the compact HK mark, hero copy remains clean and readable without layered panels, and motion stays subtle.

name: Static integrity guard
expected: Embedded JavaScript parses and the source contains no AppDeploy deployment code or copied competitor URLs/assets.

name: Triple Crown motion and section parity
expected: Hotel Kishan uses the same core scroll and section interaction patterns as Triple Crown, adapted to its own verified content and contact channels.
